title: Two-stage paediatric pneumonia detection/classification — evaluation of the 7 trained checkpoints

provenance.source: Transcribed from the console output of scripts/evaluate_stage1_ensemble.py, scripts/evaluate_stage2_ensemble.py and scripts/evaluate_full_pipeline.py --ablate, run on Google Colab against the 7 checkpoints stored on Google Drive.
provenance.transcription_note: Only aggregate metrics and confusion matrices were captured. Per-image predictions and probability scores were NOT retained, so ROC/PR curves cannot be redrawn from this file — rerun the scripts with --json to regenerate this schema, or add a per-image dump.

environment.note: GPU model and library versions were not recorded in the captured output.

dataset.name: Kermany paediatric chest X-ray (Kaggle: paultimothymooney/chest-xray-pneumonia)
dataset.split_policy: Official Kermany directory split (train/val/test), NOT the paper's stratified 80:20 random split.

stage1_split.note: train+val are the official 5,216-image training folder, split 80:20 at runtime (seed 42). There is no val/ directory on disk.

stage2_split.note: Pneumonia-only subset. Train 3,875 is split 80:20 at runtime (3,100 / 775). Test = 242 BACTERIAL + 148 VIRAL.

dataset.augmentation: On-the-fly transforms (flip, rotation, scaling, brightness/contrast). The paper instead pre-expanded bacterial 2,766->5,781 and viral 1,514->3,149 offline.

paper_targets.source: Godbole et al. 2024, Tables 2-4. The paper does not report a 3-class end-to-end figure.

members.name: vgg16
members.note: Strongest single member; AUC already exceeds the paper's ensemble AUC.

members.name: inception_v3
members.note: COLLAPSED. NORMAL recall 0.056 — predicts PNEUMONIA for almost every image. Net harmful to the ensemble (see ablations).

ensemble.weights_source: Published in the paper (Section 4.1) — reproduced exactly.
ensemble.aggregation: Weighted average of softmax probabilities (INFERRED; the paper gives no equation).
ensemble.note: High sensitivity (385/390 pneumonia caught), weak specificity (82/234 normals flagged).

members.name: inception_v3
members.family: SUBSTITUTE for Xception (torchvision has no Xception)
members.note: Documented INFERRED deviation from the paper.

ensemble.weights_source: Grid search over integers 1-6, fitted on the TEST set (the paper searched 1-15 / 1-20 and did not publish the result). Optimistic.
ensemble.note: Scored on all 390 pneumonia images, independent of Stage 1. Per-class detail was not captured for this standalone run; see pipeline.stage2_breakdown for the routed-set breakdown.

stage2_breakdown.note: Rows = true BACTERIAL/VIRAL; Stage-1 misses excluded.

error_analysis.observed_pattern: Most pipeline errors are healthy lungs flagged as pneumonia and then classified VIRAL. Viral precision (0.548) is the direct symptom; Stage 1 specificity is the root cause.

ablations.method: Re-scoring only — extra forward passes, no retraining. --ablate flag.

results.name: baseline
results.description: Paper Stage 1 weights (5/4/3/1) and equal Stage 2 weights

results.name: drop_inception_stage1
results.description: Stage 1 = VGG-16 / PneumoNet-v2 / PneumoNet-v1 only; weights renormalised 5/3/1

results.name: stage2_weights_2_3_5
results.caveat: Weights were grid-searched on this same test set; the honest gain when fitted on validation is likely 0.5-1.0 points.

results.name: both
results.description: Drop Inception from Stage 1 AND Stage 2 weights 2/3/5
results.caveat: Inherits the test-fitted Stage 2 weights caveat above.

ablations.finding: The two repairs are exactly additive (28 + 8 = 36 images) and touch disjoint error sets, i.e. they do not interact. Removing one collapsed member (Inception-v3) from Stage 1 is worth more than any reweighting.
ablations.recommended_headline_config: drop_inception_stage1 (0.8301) — it depends on no test-set fitting.

deviations_from_paper.paper: Stratified 80:20 random split over all 5,856 images; no separate validation set.
deviations_from_paper.label: DIFFERENT PROTOCOL
deviations_from_paper.impact: Largest single explanation for the accuracy gap; the project's test set is patient-disjoint and harder. The paper's split is not reproducible as published.

deviations_from_paper.label: INFERRED
deviations_from_paper.impact: torchvision ships no Xception. Unquantified but the substitute is the weakest Stage 2 member.

deviations_from_paper.label: INFERRED
deviations_from_paper.impact: Measured: the model collapsed (0.6458 accuracy, NORMAL recall 0.056) and cost the pipeline 4.48 points.

deviations_from_paper.paper: Epochs, batch size and LR decay not stated
deviations_from_paper.project: 15 epochs, batch 32, SGD lr 1e-4, no schedule
deviations_from_paper.label: DEFAULT
deviations_from_paper.impact: The two from-scratch CNNs are 11-13 points below the paper — most likely under-trained.

deviations_from_paper.label: INFERRED
deviations_from_paper.impact: Trades specificity for sensitivity: recall 0.987, precision 0.824. Part of the AUC (0.950) vs accuracy (0.785) gap.

deviations_from_paper.project: Grid search 1-6 fitted on the test set
deviations_from_paper.label: INFERRED
